verses.1:1: There was a certain man in the land of Ausitis whose name was Job; and that man was true, blameless, righteous, and God-fearing, abstaining from every evil deed.
verses.1:2: And seven sons and three daughters were born to him.
verses.1:3: And his livestock was seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred grazing female donkeys. He also had an exceedingly large household of servants and great works upon the earth; and that man was noble among those from the rising of the sun.
verses.1:4: Now his sons would gather together with one another and hold a banquet each day, bringing along their three sisters as well to eat and drink with them.
verses.1:5: And whenever the days of the banquet were completed, Job would send and purify them, rising up in the morning, and he would offer a sacrifice on their behalf according to their number, and one calf for a sin offering for their souls. For Job said, "Perhaps in their minds my sons have conceived evil thoughts toward God." Therefore, Job did thus all the days.
verses.1:6: And as this day came, behold, the angels of God came to stand before the Lord, and the devil came with them.
verses.1:7: And the Lord said to the devil, "From where have you come?" And the devil answered the Lord and said, "Having compassed the earth and walked through all that is under heaven, I am here."
verses.1:8: And the Lord said to him, "Have you turned your mind toward My servant Job? For there is none like him among those upon the earth—a blameless, true, God-fearing man, abstaining from every evil deed."
verses.1:9: Then the devil answered and said before the Lord, "Does Job revere the Lord for nothing?
verses.1:10: Have You not fenced about what is outside him, and what is inside his house, and what is around all that belongs to him on every side? You have blessed the works of his hands, and You have multiplied his livestock upon the earth.
verses.1:11: Yet send forth Your hand and touch all that he has—truly he will bless You to Your face!"
verses.1:12: Then the Lord said to the devil, "Behold, all that he has I deliver into your hand; only do not touch him." And the devil went out from the Lord.
verses.1:13: And it came to pass when this day arrived that the sons of Job and his daughters were drinking wine in the house of their eldest brother.
verses.1:14: And behold, a messenger came to Job and said to him, "The yoke of oxen were plowing, and the female donkeys were grazing near them;
verses.1:15: and raiders came and carried them away captive, and slew the servants with swords; and I alone was spared and have come to report to you."
verses.1:16: While he was yet speaking, another messenger came and said to Job, "Fire fell from heaven and burned up the sheep, and devoured the shepherds likewise; and I alone was spared and have come to report to you."
verses.1:17: While he was yet speaking, another messenger came and said to Job, "The horsemen formed three companies against us, and surrounded the camels and carried them away captive, and slew the servants with swords; and I alone was spared and have come to report to you."
verses.1:18: While he was yet speaking, another messenger came, saying to Job, "While your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking with their eldest brother,
verses.1:19: suddenly a great wind rushed out of the wilderness and struck the four corners of the house; and the house collapsed upon your children, and they perished; and I alone was spared and have come to report to you."
verses.1:20: Thereupon Job arose, tore his garments, and shaved the hair of his head; and falling to the ground, he worshiped,
verses.1:21: and said, "Naked I myself came forth from my mother's womb, and naked I shall also depart there. The Lord gave; the Lord took away. As it seemed good to the Lord, so it has come to pass; may the name of the Lord be blessed."
verses.1:22: In all these things that befell him, Job did not sin in anything before the Lord, nor did he impute folly to God.
verses.2:1: Now it came to pass when this day arrived that the angels of God came to stand before the Lord, and the devil came in the midst of them to stand before the Lord.
verses.2:2: And the Lord said to the devil, "From where do you come?" Then the devil said before the Lord, "Having journeyed through the realm under heaven and walked throughout the whole of it, I am here."
verses.2:3: And the Lord said to the devil, "Have you then given heed to My servant Job? For there is none like him among those upon the earth—a guileless, true, blameless, God-fearing man, abstaining from all evil. Still he holds fast to his innocence, though you spoke to destroy his possessions for nothing."
verses.2:4: And answering, the devil said to the Lord, "Skin for skin! All that a man possesses he will pay in full for his life.
verses.2:5: Nevertheless, send forth Your hand and touch his bones and his flesh—truly he will bless You to Your face!"
verses.2:6: And the Lord said to the devil, "Behold, I deliver him over to you; only preserve his life."
verses.2:7: So the devil went out from the Lord and struck Job with a grievous sore from his feet to his head.
verses.2:8: And he took a potsherd to scrape off the discharge, and he sat upon the dunghill outside the city.
verses.2:9: Now when much time had passed, his wife said to him, "How long will you hold out, saying, 'Behold, I wait yet a little while, awaiting the hope of my deliverance'? For behold, your memorial has vanished from the earth—sons and daughters, the birth pangs and labors of my womb, for whom I toiled in vain with hardships. And you yourself sit in the corruption of worms, passing the night in the open air, while I wander about as a hired servant from place to place and from house to house, watching for when the sun will set, that I may rest from my toils and from the pains that now grip me. Rather, speak some word against the Lord, and die!"
verses.2:10: But looking intently at her, he said to her, "You have spoken like one of the foolish women. If we have received good things from the hand of the Lord, shall we not endure evil things?" In all these things that befell him, Job did not sin in anything with his lips before God.
verses.2:11: Now when his three friends heard of all the evils that had come upon him, each came to him from his own land: Eliphaz, king of the Temanites; Bildad, ruler of the Shuhites; and Zophar, king of the Minaeans. And they came to him with one accord to comfort and to visit him.
verses.2:12: And when they saw him from afar, they did not recognize him; and crying out with a loud voice, they wept, each tearing his own robe and sprinkling earth upon himself.
verses.2:13: They sat beside him seven days and seven nights, and none of them spoke, for they saw that his affliction was grievous and exceedingly great.
verses.3:1: After this Job opened his mouth,
verses.3:3: "May the day perish on which I was born, and that night in which they said, 'Behold, a male!'
verses.3:4: May that night be darkness, and may the Lord not seek after it from above, nor may light shine into it;
verses.3:5: rather, may darkness and the shadow of death seize it, and may thick gloom come upon it.
verses.3:6: May that day and that night be accursed; may darkness carry it away; may it not belong to the days of the year, nor be numbered among the days of the months.
verses.3:7: Instead, may that night be anguish, and may neither gladness nor rejoicing come upon it;
verses.3:8: rather, may the one who curses that day curse it, the one who is about to subdue the great sea monster.
verses.3:9: May the stars of that night be darkened; may it wait and never come to illumination, and may it not behold the morning star rising,
verses.3:10: because it did not shut the gates of my mother's womb; for it would have removed trouble from my eyes.
verses.3:11: For why did I not die in the womb? And why did I come forth from the belly and not immediately perish?
verses.3:12: And why did knees receive me? And why did I nurse at breasts?
verses.3:13: Now, having lain down, I would have been quiet; having fallen asleep, I would have found rest
verses.3:14: with kings and counselors of the earth, who prided themselves upon swords,
verses.3:15: or with rulers whose gold was abundant, who filled their houses with silver,
verses.3:16: or like an untimely birth coming forth from a mother's womb, or like infants who did not see light.
verses.3:17: There the ungodly have burned out the fury of their wrath; there those weary in body have found rest;
verses.3:18: and together the eternal ones have not heard the voice of the tax collector.
verses.3:19: Small and great are there, and the servant who fears his master.
verses.3:20: For why is light given to those in bitterness, and life to souls in anguish,
verses.3:21: who long for death and do not obtain it, digging for it as for treasures,
verses.3:22: and who grow exceedingly glad if they attain it?
verses.3:23: Death is rest for a man, for God has shut him in.
verses.3:24: For groaning comes before my food, and I weep, gripped by fear.
verses.3:25: For the fear about which I was anxious has come upon me, and that which I dreaded has met me.
verses.3:26: I have neither been at peace, nor been quiet, nor found rest; rather, wrath has come upon me."
verses.4:1: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.4:2: "Have you often been spoken to in weariness? Yet who shall endure the force of your words?
verses.4:3: For if you instructed many, and encouraged the hands of the weak,
verses.4:4: and raised up the feeble with words, and bestowed courage upon powerless knees;
verses.4:5: yet now distress has come upon you and touched you, and you are dismayed.
verses.4:6: Is not your fear in folly, and your hope, and the wickedness of your way?
verses.4:7: Remember, then: who, being pure, perished, or when did the true perish root and branch?
verses.4:8: Just as I have seen those who plow wicked deeds, so those who sow them shall reap sorrows for themselves.
verses.4:9: By the command of the Lord they shall perish, and by the breath of His wrath they shall vanish away.
verses.4:10: The strength of the lion, and the voice of the lioness, and the exultation of dragons have been quenched.
verses.4:11: The ant-lion has perished for having no prey, and the cubs of lions have forsaken one another.
verses.4:12: Now if any true word had been in your speeches, none of these evils would have befallen you. Shall not my ear receive extraordinary things from Him?
verses.4:13: Now terror and a sound in the night, fear falling upon men—
verses.4:14: shuddering met me, and trembling, which greatly shook my bones;
verses.4:15: and a spirit came upon my face, and my hair and flesh shuddered.
verses.4:16: I arose, and I did not recognize it; I looked, and there was no form before my eyes, only I heard a breeze and a voice:
verses.4:17: 'What then? Shall a mortal be pure before the Lord, or a man blameless from his works?'
verses.4:18: If He does not put trust in His servants, and has perceived something crooked against His angels,
verses.4:19: then those who dwell in houses of clay—of whom we ourselves also are from the same clay—He has struck them like a moth.
verses.4:20: And from morning until evening they are no more; because they are not able to help themselves, they have perished.
verses.4:21: For He breathed upon them, and they withered away; they perished because they had no wisdom."
verses.5:1: "Now call out, if indeed anyone will answer you, or if you shall see any of the holy angels.
verses.5:2: For indeed, wrath slays a foolish man, and jealousy puts to death one who has gone astray.
verses.5:3: I myself have seen fools taking root, but immediately their habitation was devoured.
verses.5:4: May their sons be far from deliverance, and may they be mocked at the doors of inferiors, and there shall be no one to rescue them.
verses.5:5: For what those men gathered, the righteous shall eat, and they themselves shall not be delivered from evils; may their strength be drained dry.
verses.5:6: For trouble shall by no means come forth from the earth, nor shall distress sprout up from the mountains;
verses.5:7: but man is born to trouble, and the young of the vulture fly in the heights.
verses.5:8: Nevertheless, I will implore the Lord, and I will call upon the Lord, the Master of all,
verses.5:9: who does great and unsearchable things, glorious and extraordinary things, of which there is no number;
verses.5:10: who gives rain upon the earth, sending water upon the land under heaven;
verses.5:11: who sets the lowly on high, and raises up those who are lost;
verses.5:12: who overturns the counsels of the crafty, and their hands shall by no means accomplish anything true.
verses.5:13: He is the One who seizes the wise in shrewdness, and He has confounded the counsel of the devious;
verses.5:14: by day darkness shall meet them, and at noonday may they grope as in the night.
verses.5:15: And may they perish in war, and may the powerless go forth from the hand of the powerful;
verses.5:16: and may there be hope for the powerless, and may the mouth of the unjust be stopped.
verses.5:17: Now blessed is the man whom the Lord has reproved; and do not reject the admonition of the Almighty.
verses.5:18: For He Himself causes pain, and again He restores; He has struck, and His hands have healed.
verses.5:19: Six times He shall deliver you out of distresses, and in the seventh, evil shall by no means touch you.
verses.5:20: In famine He shall rescue you from death, and in war He shall release you from the hand of iron.
verses.5:21: From the scourge of the tongue He shall hide you, and you shall by no means be afraid of coming evils.
verses.5:22: You shall laugh at the unjust and the lawless, and you shall by no means be afraid of wild beasts;
verses.5:23: for wild beasts shall be at peace with you.
verses.5:24: Then you shall know that your house shall be at peace, and the habitation of your tent shall by no means fail.
verses.5:25: And you shall know that your seed is abundant, and your children shall be like all the herbage of the field.
verses.5:26: And you shall come to the grave like ripe grain reaped in due season, or like a stack of the threshing floor gathered in at its proper time.
verses.5:27: Behold, thus we have searched out these things; these are the things we have heard; now know for yourself whether you have done anything."
verses.6:2: "Oh, that someone would indeed weigh my wrath, and lift up my sorrows in a balance together,
verses.6:3: then indeed it would be heavier than the sand of the seashore; yet, as it seems, my words are worthless.
verses.6:4: For the arrows of the Lord are in my body, whose fury drinks up my blood; whenever I begin to speak, they pierce me.
verses.6:5: For why? Will a wild donkey cry out in vain, unless it is seeking its food? Or will an ox raise its voice at the manger while it has its fodder?
verses.6:6: Shall bread be eaten without salt? Or is there indeed any taste in empty words?
verses.6:7: For my wrath cannot cease; for I perceive my food as a stench, like the smell of a lion.
verses.6:8: Oh, that He would grant it, and that my request might come to pass, and that the Lord would grant my hope!
verses.6:9: Having begun, let the Lord wound me, yet let Him not utterly destroy me.
verses.6:10: May a grave be my city, upon whose walls I leaped. I will not hold back; for I have not falsified the holy words of my God.
verses.6:11: For what is my strength, that I endure? Or what is my time, that my soul bears up?
verses.6:12: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?
verses.6:13: Or did I not trust in Him? Yet help is absent from me.
verses.6:14: Mercy has renounced me, and the visitation of the Lord has overlooked me.
verses.6:15: My nearest kin have not looked upon me; like a failing torrent, or like a wave, they have passed me by;
verses.6:16: those who used to stand in awe of me have now fallen upon me like snow or frozen ice,
verses.6:17: just as when it melts as heat comes, it is no longer recognized for what it was;
verses.6:18: so I also have been forsaken by all, and I have perished and become homeless.
verses.6:19: Look upon the ways of the Temanites, the paths of the Sabeans, you who observe;
verses.6:20: and those who trust in cities and wealth shall incur shame.
verses.6:21: Yet you also have come against me without mercy; therefore, seeing my wound, be afraid!
verses.6:22: For why? Have I asked anything of you? Or do I have need of strength from you,
verses.6:23: to save me from enemies, or to deliver me from the hand of the mighty?
verses.6:24: Teach me, and I will be silent; if I have erred in anything, declare it to me.
verses.6:25: Yet, as it seems, the words of a truthful man are worthless; for I do not ask for strength from you,
verses.6:26: nor will your reproof stop me with words; for neither will I endure the sound of your speech.
verses.6:27: Nevertheless, you fall upon an orphan, and you leap upon your friend.
verses.6:28: And now, looking into your faces, I will not lie.
verses.6:29: Sit down now, and let there be no injustice; and come together again with what is right.
verses.6:30: For there is no injustice on my tongue; or does not my throat meditate on understanding?"
verses.7:1: "Is not the life of man upon the earth a trial, and his existence like that of a day laborer?
verses.7:2: Or like a servant who fears his master and has found shade, or like a hired worker awaiting his wages?
verses.7:3: So I also have endured empty months, and nights of pain have been given to me.
verses.7:4: When I lie down, I say, 'When will it be day?' And when I rise up, again, 'When will it be evening?' And I am filled with pains from evening until morning.
verses.7:5: And my body is defiled with the decay of worms, and I dissolve clods of earth as I scrape away the discharge.
verses.7:6: And my life is swifter than speech, and it has perished in empty hope.
verses.7:7: Remember therefore that my life is a breath, and my eye shall no more return to see good.
verses.7:8: The eye of him who sees me shall look upon me no more; Your eyes are upon me, and I am no more,
verses.7:9: like a cloud cleared away from the sky. For if a man goes down to Hades, he shall never again come up,
verses.7:10: nor shall he ever return to his own house, nor shall his place ever recognize him again.
verses.7:11: Therefore neither will I restrain my mouth; I will speak while in distress; being hard pressed, I will open the bitterness of my soul.
verses.7:12: Am I a sea, or a dragon, that You have set a watch over me?
verses.7:13: I said, 'My bed will comfort me, and I will hold private discourse with myself upon my couch;'
verses.7:14: You terrify me with dreams, and dismay me through visions.
verses.7:15: You will separate my soul from my spirit, and my bones from death.
verses.7:16: For I shall not live forever, that I should be patient; depart from me, for my life is empty.
verses.7:17: For what is man, that You have magnified him? Or that You set Your mind upon him?
verses.7:18: Or that You will visit him until the morning, and judge him until rest?
verses.7:19: How long will You not leave me alone, nor let me go, until I swallow my spittle in pain?
verses.7:20: If I have sinned, what shall I be able to do, O You who know the mind of men? Why have You set me as Your accuser, and why am I a burden upon You?
verses.7:21: And why have You not made a forgetting of my iniquity and a cleansing of my sin? For now I shall depart into the earth, and rising at dawn, I am no more."
verses.8:1: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.8:2: "How long will you speak these things? The wind of your mouth is full of many words.
verses.8:3: Will the Lord act unjustly in judgment? Or will He who made all things confound justice?
verses.8:4: If your sons sinned before Him, He sent them away into the hand of their iniquity.
verses.8:5: But you, rise early to seek the Lord Almighty, making supplication.
verses.8:6: If you are pure and true, He will listen to your supplication, and He will restore to you a habitation of righteousness.
verses.8:7: Therefore your former things shall be small, but your latter things shall be beyond telling.
verses.8:8: For inquire of the former generation, and search out according to the lineage of the fathers;
verses.8:9: for we are of yesterday and do not know, because our life upon the earth is a shadow.
verses.8:10: Will they not teach you and declare to you, and bring forth words from the heart?
verses.8:11: Does the papyrus flourish without water? Or will the marsh sedge grow tall without drink?
verses.8:12: While it is still upon its root and shall by no means be harvested, before drinking does not every herb dry up?
verses.8:13: So therefore shall be the end of all those who forget the Lord; for the hope of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.8:14: For his house shall be uninhabited, and his tent shall turn into a spider's web.
verses.8:15: If he props up his house, it shall by no means stand; and when he takes hold of it, it shall by no means endure;
verses.8:16: for he is full of sap beneath the sun, and out of his decay his young shoot shall come forth.
verses.8:17: Upon a heap of stones he lies down, and in the midst of pebbles he shall live.
verses.8:18: If it swallows him up, the place shall deny him; you have not seen such things.
verses.8:19: For such is the overthrow of the ungodly, and out of the earth it shall cause another to spring up.
verses.8:20: For the Lord shall by no means cast off the innocent, nor will He accept any gift of the ungodly.
verses.8:21: Yet He will fill the mouth of the true with laughter, and their lips with thanksgiving;
verses.8:22: and their enemies shall be clothed with shame, and the habitation of the ungodly shall be no more."
verses.9:2: "In truth I know that it is so; for how shall a mortal be righteous before the Lord?
verses.9:3: For if he desires to contend in judgment with Him, He will by no means answer him, so that he may not reply against one word of His out of a thousand.
verses.9:4: For He is wise in understanding, both mighty and great; who has become stubborn before Him and endured?
verses.9:5: He who wears away the mountains, and they do not know it; He who overturns them in wrath;
verses.9:6: He who shakes the earth beneath heaven from its foundations, and its pillars tremble;
verses.9:7: He who speaks to the sun, and it does not rise, and who seals up the stars;
verses.9:8: He who stretched out the heaven alone, walking upon the sea as upon firm ground;
verses.9:9: He who makes the Pleiades and Hesperus and Arcturus, and the chambers of the South;
verses.9:10: He who does great and unsearchable things, both glorious and marvelous things, of which there is no number.
verses.9:11: If He passes over me, I shall by no means see Him; and if He passes by me, not even then do I perceive it.
verses.9:12: If He takes away, who will turn Him back? Or who will say to Him, 'What have You done?'
verses.9:13: For He Himself has turned aside wrath; by Him the sea monsters beneath heaven were bowed down.
verses.9:14: And if He will listen to me, surely He will judge my words.
verses.9:15: For even if I am righteous, He will not hear me; I will make supplication for His judgment.
verses.9:16: And if I call and He does not answer, I do not believe that He has heard me.
verses.9:17: Will He crush me with thick darkness? Yet He has made my bruises many without cause.
verses.9:18: For He does not allow me to draw breath, but He has filled me with bitterness.
verses.9:19: For indeed, because He is strong, He prevails; who then shall withstand His judgment?
verses.9:20: For if I am righteous, my mouth will speak impiously; and if I am blameless, I shall turn out crooked.
verses.9:21: For even if I have acted impiously, I do not know it in my soul; yet my life is taken away.
verses.9:22: Therefore I said, 'Wrath destroys the great and the mighty,'
verses.9:23: for the worthless are in an extraordinary death, yet the righteous are mocked;
verses.9:24: for they have been delivered into the hands of an ungodly man. He covers the faces of its judges; and if it is not He, who is it?
verses.9:25: Now my life is swifter than a runner; they fled away, and they did not see.
verses.9:26: Or is there indeed a track of a way for ships, or of a flying eagle seeking prey?
verses.9:27: For even if I speak, I shall forget while speaking; bowing down my face, I shall groan.
verses.9:28: I tremble in all my limbs, for I know that You will not leave me guiltless.
verses.9:29: And since I am ungodly, why did I not die?
verses.9:30: For if I wash myself with snow, and cleanse myself with clean hands,
verses.9:31: You have plunged me thoroughly in filth, and my robe has abhorred me.
verses.9:32: For You are not a man like me with whom I may contend, that we should come together with one accord into judgment.
verses.9:33: Oh, that there were a mediator for us, both reproving and hearing between us both;
verses.9:34: let Him remove the rod from me, and let His terror not confound me,
verses.9:35: and I shall by no means be afraid, but I will speak; for I am not conscious of being so."
verses.10:1: I am weary in my soul. Groaning, I will let loose my words against Him; I will speak, oppressed by the bitterness of my soul,
verses.10:2: and I will say to the Lord, "Do not teach me to be ungodly; and why have You judged me thus?
verses.10:3: Is it good to You if I do wrong, that I should renounce the works of Your hands, while You have given heed to the counsel of the ungodly?
verses.10:4: Do You observe as a mortal sees, or will You look as a man sees?
verses.10:5: Is Your life human, or are Your years those of a man,
verses.10:6: that You have searched out my iniquity and traced out my sins?
verses.10:7: For You know that I have not acted ungodly; yet who is there who delivers out of Your hands?
verses.10:8: Your hands formed me and made me; afterward, turning about, You struck me.
verses.10:9: Remember that You formed me as clay, and to earth You turn me back again.
verses.10:10: Did You not milk me like milk, and curdle me like cheese?
verses.10:11: With skin and flesh You clothed me, and with bones and sinews You wove me together.
verses.10:12: Life and mercy You placed with me, and Your visitation has guarded my spirit.
verses.10:13: Having these things within Yourself, I know that You can do all things, and nothing is impossible for You.
verses.10:14: For if I sin, You watch closely over me, and from iniquity You have not made me guiltless.
verses.10:15: For if I act ungodly, woe to me! And if I am righteous, I cannot lift up my head, for I am full of dishonor.
verses.10:16: For I am hunted like a lion for slaughter; for turning again, You dreadfully destroy me,
verses.10:17: renewing my examination against me; You have dealt with me in great wrath, and You have brought trials upon me.
verses.10:18: Why then did You bring me forth from the womb, and why did I not die, that no eye might see me,
verses.10:19: and that I might become as one who does not exist? For why was I not taken away from the womb to the tomb?
verses.10:20: Is not the span of my time brief? Leave me alone to rest a little,
verses.10:21: before I go to the place from which I shall not return, to a land dark and gloomy,
verses.10:22: to a land of everlasting darkness, where there is no light, nor to behold the life of mortals."
verses.11:1: Then Zophar the Minaean answered and said:
verses.11:2: "He who speaks many things shall also hear in reply; or does the man of fluent speech suppose he is righteous?
verses.11:3: Blessed is the short-lived man born of woman. Do not be abundant in words, for there is no one answering against you.
verses.11:4: For do not say, 'I am pure in my works, and blameless before Him.'
verses.11:5: Yet how might the Lord speak to you, and open His lips with you?
verses.11:6: Then He will declare to you the power of wisdom, that it shall be double that which pertains to you; and then you shall know that what has befallen you from the Lord is worthy of the sins you have committed.
verses.11:7: Will you find the trace of the Lord? Or have you arrived at the uttermost bounds that the Almighty has made?
verses.11:8: Heaven is high, and what will you do? Deeper are they than the things in Hades—what do you know?
verses.11:9: Or longer than the measure of the earth, or than the breadth of the sea.
verses.11:10: And if He overturns all things, who will say to Him, 'What have You done?'
verses.11:11: For He Himself knows the works of lawless men, and seeing wicked deeds, He will not overlook them.
verses.11:12: Yet man idly swims in words, and a mortal born of woman is like a donkey of the desert.
verses.11:13: For if you have made your heart pure, and stretch out your hands toward Him;
verses.11:14: if there is anything lawless in your hands, put it far away from you, and do not let unrighteousness lodge in your dwelling.
verses.11:15: For thus your face shall shine forth like pure water, and you shall put off filth and shall by no means be afraid;
verses.11:16: and you shall forget your trouble like a wave that has passed by, and you shall not be terrified;
verses.11:17: and your prayer shall be like the morning star, and out of noonday life shall rise for you;
verses.11:18: and you shall be confident that there is hope for you, and out of anxiety and care, peace shall appear to you.
verses.11:19: For you shall be at rest, and there shall be no one making war against you; and turning around, many shall make supplication to you.
verses.11:20: Yet salvation shall forsake them; for their hope is destruction, and the eyes of the ungodly shall melt away."
verses.12:2: "So then, you are the people; surely wisdom shall die with you.
verses.12:3: Indeed, I also have a heart like yours.
verses.12:4: For a righteous and blameless man has become a mockery;
verses.12:5: for at an appointed time he had been prepared to fall by others, and his houses to be plundered by lawless men.
verses.12:6: Nevertheless, let no one who is wicked trust that he shall be guiltless—all who provoke the Lord to anger—as though there shall not also be an examination of them.
verses.12:7: Now ask the four-footed beasts, if they will tell you, and the birds of heaven, if they will declare it to you;
verses.12:8: speak to the earth, if it will explain to you, and the fish of the sea shall recount it to you.
verses.12:9: Who then has not known in all these things that the hand of the Lord has made these things?
verses.12:10: Is not the soul of all living things in His hand, and the spirit of every man?
verses.12:11: For the mind discerns words, and the throat tastes food.
verses.12:12: In much time is wisdom, and in long life is knowledge.
verses.12:13: With Him are wisdom and power; to Him belong counsel and understanding.
verses.12:14: If He tears down, who shall build up? If He shuts up against men, who shall open?
verses.12:15: If He withholds the water, He will dry up the earth; and if He sends it forth, He destroys it, overturning it.
verses.12:16: With Him are might and strength; to Him belong knowledge and understanding.
verses.12:17: He leads away counselors as captives, and drives the judges of the earth out of their senses.
verses.12:18: He seats kings upon thrones, and binds their loins with a belt.
verses.12:19: He sends away priests as captives, and overthrows the mighty men of the earth.
verses.12:20: He changes the lips of the faithful, and knows the understanding of the elders.
verses.12:21: He pours out dishonor upon rulers, and heals the lowly.
verses.12:22: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings the shadow of death out into light.
verses.12:23: He lays nations low and guides them.
verses.12:24: He changes the hearts of the rulers of the earth, and causes them to wander in a way that they did not know;
verses.12:25: may they grope in darkness and not in light, and may they stagger like a drunken man."
verses.13:1: Behold, my eye has seen these things, and my ear has heard them.
verses.13:2: And I know as much as you also understand, and I am no less discerning than you.
verses.13:3: Nevertheless, I will speak to the Lord, and I will reason before Him, if He wills.
verses.13:4: But you are unjust physicians, and healers of evils, all of you.
verses.13:5: May it be yours to keep silent, and it shall turn out to be wisdom for you.
verses.13:6: Hear the reproof of my mouth, and give heed to the judgment of my lips.
verses.13:7: Do you not speak before the Lord, and utter deceit before Him?
verses.13:8: Or will you shrink back? Rather, become judges yourselves.
verses.13:9: For would it be good if He searches you out? For if, doing all things, you attach yourselves to Him,
verses.13:10: He will reprove you nonetheless; and if even in secret you show partiality,
verses.13:11: will not His terrors whirl you about? And dread from Him shall fall upon you,
verses.13:12: and your boasting shall turn out like ashes, and your body made of clay.
verses.13:13: Keep silent, that I may speak and find rest from wrath,
verses.13:14: taking up my flesh in my teeth, and I will place my life in my hand.
verses.13:15: Though the Mighty One overpower me, seeing that He has already begun, yet surely I will speak and reason before Him;
verses.13:16: and this shall turn out for my salvation, for deceit shall not enter before Him.
verses.13:17: Hear, hear my words, for I will declare them in your hearing.
verses.13:18: Behold, I am near to my judgment; I know that I shall be shown righteous.
verses.13:19: For who is he who will contend with me, that now I shall keep silent and expire?
verses.13:20: Only grant me two things, and then I will not hide myself from Your face:
verses.13:21: withhold Your hand from me, and do not let Your dread terrify me.
verses.13:22: Then You will call, and I will answer You; or You will speak, and I will give You a reply.
verses.13:23: How many are my sins and my iniquities? Teach me what they are.
verses.13:24: Why do You hide Yourself from me, and count me as an adversary to You?
verses.13:25: Will You be wary of a leaf stirred by the wind, or do You set Yourself against me as against grass carried by a gust?
verses.13:26: For You have written evils against me, and You have laid upon me the sins of youth;
verses.13:27: and You have set my foot in a restraint, and You have watched all my works, and You have reached to the roots of my feet,
verses.13:28: which wears out like a wineskin, or like a moth-eaten garment.
verses.14:1: For a mortal born of woman is short-lived and full of wrath,
verses.14:2: or like a flower that has blossomed, he falls away, and he flees like a shadow and shall by no means remain.
verses.14:3: Have You not taken account even of this one, and caused this one to enter into judgment before You?
verses.14:4: For who shall be clean from defilement? Indeed, not one,
verses.14:5: even if his life upon the earth is one day; and his months are numbered by Him; You have set a time, and he shall by no means pass beyond it.
verses.14:6: Withdraw from him, that he may have rest and take pleasure in life, like a hired laborer.
verses.14:7: For there is hope for a tree: for if it is cut down, it will blossom again, and its tender shoot shall never fail;
verses.14:8: for though its root grows old in the earth, and in a rock dies
verses.14:9: its stump, at the scent of water it will bloom and produce a harvest like a young plant.
verses.14:10: But a man, having died, is gone; and a mortal, having fallen, is no more.
verses.14:11: For in time a sea is depleted, and a river, laid desolate, dries up.
verses.14:12: So man, having fallen asleep, shall by no means rise until the heaven is no longer sewn together, and they shall not be awakened from their sleep.
verses.14:13: Oh, that You had kept me in Hades, and hidden me until Your wrath should cease, and appointed for me a time in which You would remember me!
verses.14:14: For if a man dies, he shall live, having completed the days of his life; I will wait until I come into being again.
verses.14:15: Then You will call, and I will answer You; and do not reject the works of Your hands.
verses.14:16: Yet You have numbered my practices, and not one of my sins shall escape You;
verses.14:17: and You have sealed up my iniquities in a bag, and You have marked down if I transgressed anything unwillingly.
verses.14:18: And indeed, a falling mountain shall crumble away, and a rock shall wear away from its place;
verses.14:19: waters grind smooth the stones, and waters wash away the level surfaces of the soil of the earth; and You have destroyed the endurance of man.
verses.14:20: You have thrust him away forever, and he is gone; You have set Your face against him and sent him away;
verses.14:21: and though his sons become many, he does not know it; and if they become few, he does not perceive it;
verses.14:22: only his flesh suffers pain, and his soul mourns.
verses.15:1: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.15:2: "Will a wise man give an answer of windy understanding, and fill up pain of the belly,
verses.15:3: reproving with words that are not fitting, with speeches in which there is no profit?
verses.15:4: Have you not also cast off fear, and consummated such words before the Lord?
verses.15:5: You are guilty by the words of your mouth, and you have not discerned the words of the mighty.
verses.15:6: May your own mouth convict you, and not I; and your lips shall testify against you.
verses.15:7: What then? Were you born the first of men? Or were you fashioned before the hills?
verses.15:8: Or have you heard the decree of the Lord? And has wisdom come to you?
verses.15:9: For what do you know that we do not know? Or what do you understand that we also do not?
verses.15:10: Indeed, both the elder and the very aged are among us, weightier in days than your father.
verses.15:11: For little of what you have sinned have you been scourged; you have spoken greatly beyond measure.
verses.15:12: What has your heart dared? Or what have your eyes aimed at,
verses.15:13: that you have broken out in wrath before the Lord, and brought forth such words from your mouth?
verses.15:14: For what is a mortal, that he should be blameless, or one born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.15:15: If He does not put trust in holy ones, and heaven is not clean before Him,
verses.15:16: how much less one who is abominable and unclean, a man who drinks iniquities like a drink!
verses.15:17: But I will declare to you, hear me; what indeed I have seen I will declare to you,
verses.15:18: what wise men shall tell, and did not conceal their fathers;
verses.15:19: to them alone the land was given, and no foreigner came upon them.
verses.15:20: All the life of an ungodly man is in anxiety, and numbered years are given to a tyrant,
verses.15:21: and his terror is in his ears; when he seems already to be at peace, his overthrow shall come.
verses.15:22: Let him not trust that he will return from darkness, for he is already appointed into the hands of iron,
verses.15:23: and he is assigned as food for vultures; and he knows within himself that he remains for a carcass. And a dark day shall whirl him about,
verses.15:24: and distress and tribulation shall seize him like a commander falling in the front rank;
verses.15:25: because he has lifted up his hands against the Lord, and has stiffened his neck before the Lord Almighty,
verses.15:26: and has run against Him in insolence, with the thickness of the back of his shield;
verses.15:27: because he has covered his face with his fat, and has made a fold upon his thighs.
verses.15:28: May he lodge in desolate cities, and may he enter into uninhabited houses; and what they prepared, others shall carry away.
verses.15:29: Neither shall he become rich, nor shall his possessions remain; he shall not cast a shadow upon the earth,
verses.15:30: nor shall he escape the darkness; may the wind wither his shoot, and may his blossom fall away.
verses.15:31: Let him not trust that he will endure, for empty things shall turn out for him;
verses.15:32: his cutting shall perish before its season, and his branch shall never grow thick;
verses.15:33: and may he be gathered like an unripe grape before its season, and may he fall away like the blossom of an olive tree.
verses.15:34: For the testimony of the ungodly is death, and fire shall burn the houses of those who receive bribes.
verses.15:35: And he shall conceive pains, and empty things shall turn out for him, and his belly shall bring forth deceit."
verses.16:2: "I have heard many such things; you are all comforters of evils.
verses.16:3: What then? Is there order in words of wind? Or what will trouble you that you answer?
verses.16:4: I also will speak just as you do. If indeed your soul were in place of mine, then I would leap upon you with words, and shake my head against you.
verses.16:5: And may there be strength in my mouth, and I will not spare the movement of my lips.
verses.16:6: For if I speak, I shall not feel the pain of the wound; and even if I keep silent, how much less shall I be wounded?
verses.16:7: But now He has made me weary, foolish, decayed, and You have laid hold of me;
verses.16:8: it has become a testimony; and my falsehood has risen up within me, and has answered back to my face.
verses.16:9: Dealing in wrath, He has cast me down; He has gnashed His teeth at me; the arrows of His raiders have fallen upon me.
verses.16:10: With the sharp barbs of His eyes He has leaped upon me; with a sharp point He has struck me on the knees, and with one accord they have rushed down upon me.
verses.16:11: For the Lord has delivered me into the hands of an unrighteous man, and He has cast me upon the ungodly.
verses.16:12: While I was at peace, He scattered me; taking me by the hair, He plucked me, and He set me up as a target.
verses.16:13: They surrounded me with spears, striking into my kidneys; without sparing, they poured out my gall upon the ground;
verses.16:14: they cast me down, fall upon fall; they rushed against me as mighty men;
verses.16:15: they sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and my strength has been quenched in the earth.
verses.16:16: My belly is scorched from weeping, and upon my eyelids is a shadow;
verses.16:17: yet there was nothing unrighteous in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
verses.16:18: O earth, do not cover over the blood of my flesh, and let there be no place for my cry.
verses.16:19: And now, behold, my witness is in the heavens, and He who knows with me is in the highest places.
verses.16:20: May my supplication reach the Lord, and before Him may my eye shed tears.
verses.16:21: And may there be a plea for a man before the Lord, and for a son of man with his neighbor.
verses.16:22: And numbered years have come, and I shall go by the way on which I shall not return."
verses.17:1: I am perishing, carried away by the wind; I plead for burial, yet I do not obtain it.
verses.17:2: I implore in my weariness—and what have I done?
verses.17:3: Strangers have stolen my possessions. Who is this man? Let him be bound to my hand.
verses.17:4: Because You have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore You will by no means exalt them.
verses.17:5: He will report evils for a portion, and eyes have wasted away over sons.
verses.17:6: You have made me a byword among the nations, and I have become a laughingstock to them.
verses.17:7: For my eyes have grown dim from wrath, and I have been greatly besieged by all.
verses.17:8: Astonishment has seized the upright at this, and may the righteous rise up against the lawless.
verses.17:9: May the faithful hold fast to his own way, and may the one clean of hands take courage.
verses.17:10: Nevertheless, all of you press on, and come now, for I do not find anything true among you.
verses.17:11: My days have passed away in tumult, and the joints of my heart have been broken.
verses.17:12: I have turned night into day; light is near before the face of darkness.
verses.17:13: For if I wait, Hades is my house, and in thick darkness my bed is spread.
verses.17:14: I have called upon death to be my father, and corruption to be my mother and my sister.
verses.17:15: Where then is my hope any longer? Or shall I see my good things?
verses.17:16: Will they go down with me into Hades, or shall we go down together to the dust?
verses.18:1: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,
verses.18:2: "How long will you not cease? Hold back, so that we ourselves may also speak.
verses.18:3: Why have we been silent before you like four-footed beasts?
verses.18:4: Wrath has taken hold of you. What then? If you die, will the world under heaven be uninhabited? Or shall mountains be overturned from their foundations?
verses.18:5: And the light of the ungodly shall be extinguished, and their flame shall not come forth.
verses.18:6: His light is darkness in his dwelling, and his lamp shall be extinguished beside him.
verses.18:7: May the least of men prey upon his possessions, and may his counsel fail.
verses.18:8: His foot has been cast into a snare; may he be entangled in a net.
verses.18:9: May snares come upon him; He will strengthen the thirsty against him.
verses.18:10: A cord for him is hidden in the ground, and a trap for him upon the paths.
verses.18:11: May pains destroy him all around, and may many come about his foot in dire famine,
verses.18:12: and a dreadful downfall has been prepared for him.
verses.18:13: May the branches of his feet be devoured, and death shall devour his beauty.
verses.18:14: May healing be torn away from his dwelling, and may distress seize him on a royal charge.
verses.18:15: It shall dwell in his tent in his night; his stately possessions shall be strewn with brimstone.
verses.18:16: From beneath his roots shall dry up, and from above his harvest shall fall down.
verses.18:17: May his memorial perish from the earth, and a name belongs to him upon the face outside.
verses.18:18: May He thrust him from light into darkness.
verses.18:19: He shall not be recognized among his people, nor shall his house be preserved in the world under heaven,
verses.18:20: but others shall live in his estate. The last groaned over him, and astonishment seized the first.
verses.18:21: These are the houses of the unrighteous, and this is the place of those who do not know the Lord."
verses.19:2: "How long will you weary my soul, and tear me down with words? Know only that the Lord has made me thus;
verses.19:3: you speak against me; without shame before me, you press hard upon me.
verses.19:4: Yes indeed, in truth I have gone astray, and error lodges with me, to speak words that ought not to be spoken, and my words go astray and are out of season.
verses.19:5: Come now, surely you magnify yourselves against me, and you leap upon me with reproach.
verses.19:6: Know therefore that it is the Lord who has troubled me, and He has raised up His stronghold against me.
verses.19:7: Behold, I laugh at reproach and will not speak; I will cry out, and nowhere is there justice.
verses.19:8: I am walled in all around, and I can by no means pass through; He has set darkness upon my face.
verses.19:9: He has stripped glory from me, and taken away the crown from my head.
verses.19:10: He has torn me apart all around, and I am gone; He has cut down my hope like a tree.
verses.19:11: Fiercely He has dealt with me in wrath, and He has regarded me as an enemy.
verses.19:12: With one accord His raiding bands came upon me; those lying in ambush surrounded my ways.
verses.19:13: My brethren have departed from me; they have recognized strangers rather than me, and my friends have become merciless.
verses.19:14: My nearest kin have not acknowledged me, and those who knew my name have forgotten me.
verses.19:15: Neighbors of my house and my maidservants—I was a foreigner before them.
verses.19:16: I called my servant, and he did not answer; my mouth pleaded,
verses.19:17: and I implored my wife, and coaxingly called to the sons of my concubines;
verses.19:18: yet they rejected me forever; whenever I rise up, they speak against me.
verses.19:19: Those who saw me abhorred me; those whom I had loved have risen up against me.
verses.19:20: Within my skin my flesh has rotted away, and my bones are held in my teeth.
verses.19:21: Have mercy on me, have mercy on me, O friends, for it is the hand of the Lord that has touched me.
verses.19:22: Why do you persecute me just as the Lord also does, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.19:23: For who would grant that my words might be written, and that they might be placed in a book forever,
verses.19:24: with an iron stylus and lead?
verses.19:25: For I know that He who is about to deliver me is eternal;
verses.19:26: upon the earth may He raise up my skin that endures these things! For from the Lord these things have been accomplished for me,
verses.19:27: which I myself know within me, which my eye has seen and not another; and all things have been accomplished for me in my bosom.
verses.19:28: And if you also say, 'What shall we say before him? And we shall find a root of the matter in him,'
verses.19:29: then you yourselves also beware of concealment; for wrath shall come upon the lawless, and then they shall know where their substance is."
verses.20:1: Then Zophar the Minaean answered and said:
verses.20:2: "I did not suppose that you would answer these things thus, and you do not understand more than I also.
verses.20:3: I shall hear the reproof of my shame, and a spirit out of understanding shall answer me.
verses.20:4: Have you not known these things from of old, since man was placed upon the earth?
verses.20:5: For the gladness of the ungodly is a dreadful downfall, and the rejoicing of the lawless is destruction;
verses.20:6: even if his gifts should ascend to heaven, and his sacrifice touch the clouds.
verses.20:7: For when he supposes that he is now firmly established, then he shall utterly perish; and those who knew him shall say, 'Where is he?'
verses.20:8: Like a dream that has flown away, he shall by no means be found, and he has taken flight like a vision of the night;
verses.20:9: An eye glanced upon him, and shall do so no more, and his place shall behold him no longer.
verses.20:10: May lesser men destroy his sons, and may his hands burn with pains.
verses.20:11: His bones were filled with his youth, and with him it shall lie down upon the dust.
verses.20:12: Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, he will hide it beneath his tongue,
verses.20:13: he will not spare it and will not forsake it, and he will gather it in the midst of his throat,
verses.20:14: and he shall by no means be able to help himself; the gall of an asp is within his belly.
verses.20:15: Wealth unjustly gathered shall be vomited up; an angel shall drag him out of his house.
verses.20:16: May he suck the venom of dragons, and may the tongue of a serpent slay him.
verses.20:17: May he not behold the milking of the flocks, nor the pastures of honey and butter.
verses.20:18: For empty and vain things he has labored, for wealth of which he shall not taste—like tough gristle, unchewed, unswallowed.
verses.20:19: For he has crushed the houses of many mighty men; he has seized a dwelling, and did not establish it.
verses.20:20: There is no safety for his possessions; in his desire he shall not be saved.
verses.20:21: There is no remnant left of his provisions; therefore his good things shall not flourish.
verses.20:22: And when he supposes that he is now filled, he shall be afflicted, and every distress shall come upon him.
verses.20:23: If by any means he should fill his belly, may He send forth upon him the fury of wrath; may He rain pains upon him;
verses.20:24: and he shall by no means be saved from the hand of iron; may a bow of bronze wound him;
verses.20:25: and may an arrow pass through his body, and may stars walk about in his dwellings; terrors are upon him,
verses.20:26: and may all darkness await him; an unkindled fire shall devour him, and may a stranger afflict his house.
verses.20:27: And may heaven uncover his iniquities, and may the earth rise up against him.
verses.20:28: May destruction utterly drag away his house; may a day of wrath come upon him.
verses.20:29: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and the possession of what belongs to him from the Overseer."
verses.21:2: "Hear, hear my words, so that this consolation may not be mine from you.
verses.21:3: Bear with me, and I will speak; then you shall not mock me.
verses.21:4: What then? Is my reproof against a man? Or why shall I not be moved to wrath?
verses.21:5: Looking upon me, you shall be astonished, putting your hand upon your cheek.
verses.21:6: For even when I remember, I am dismayed, and pains lay hold upon my flesh.
verses.21:7: Why do the ungodly live, and have also grown old in wealth?
verses.21:8: Their seed is according to their soul's desire, and their children are before their eyes.
verses.21:9: Their houses prosper, and fear is nowhere, and there is no scourge upon them from the Lord.
verses.21:10: Their cow has not miscarried, and their one with young has come safely through and has not failed.
verses.21:11: And they abide like everlasting sheep, and their little children play about;
verses.21:12: taking up the psaltery and the harp, they rejoice at the sound of a psalm.
verses.21:13: And they have completed their life in good things, and in the rest of Hades they have fallen asleep.
verses.21:14: Yet he says to the Lord, 'Depart from me; I do not desire to know Your ways;
verses.21:15: What is the Sufficient One, that we shall serve Him? And what profit is there that we shall meet Him?'
verses.21:16: For their good things were in their hands, and He does not look upon the works of the ungodly.
verses.21:17: Nevertheless, the lamp of the ungodly shall also be extinguished, and overthrow shall come upon them, and pangs shall seize them from wrath.
verses.21:18: And they shall be like chaff driven by the wind, or like dust which a whirlwind has snatched away.
verses.21:19: May his possessions fail his sons; He shall repay him, and he shall know.
verses.21:20: May his eyes behold his own slaughter, and may he not be saved from the Lord;
verses.21:21: for his desire is in his house with him, and the numbers of his months have been divided.
verses.21:22: Is it not the Lord who teaches understanding and knowledge? And He Himself shall judge murders.
verses.21:23: This one shall die in the strength of his simplicity, altogether in comfort and prospering,
verses.21:24: and his inward parts are full of fat, and his marrow is diffused;
verses.21:25: while another dies from bitterness of soul, having eaten no good thing;
verses.21:26: yet together they lie down upon the earth, and corruption has covered them.
verses.21:27: Therefore I know you, that with presumption you press upon me,
verses.21:28: so that you will say, 'Where is the house of a ruler? And where is the shelter of the tents of the ungodly?'
verses.21:29: Ask those who pass by along the way, and you shall not disown their signs;
verses.21:30: for the wicked man is spared for the day of destruction; to the day of His wrath they shall be led away.
verses.21:31: Who shall declare his way before his face? And what he himself has done, who shall repay him?
verses.21:32: And he himself was carried away to the tombs, and he himself kept watch upon the mounds.
verses.21:33: The pebbles of the torrent have been sweet to him, and every man shall depart after him, and those before him are innumerable.
verses.21:34: How then do you comfort me in vain? And as for my finding rest from you, it is nothing."
verses.22:1: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.22:2: "Is it not the Lord who teaches understanding and knowledge?
verses.22:3: For what does it matter to the Lord if you were blameless in your works? Or is it any gain that you put away your way?
verses.22:4: Or taking account of you, will He reprove you, and enter with you into judgment?
verses.22:5: Is not your wickedness great, and are not your sins innumerable?
verses.22:6: For you took pledges from your brethren for nothing, and you stripped away the clothing of the naked;
verses.22:7: neither did you give the thirsty water to drink, but you deprived the hungry of a morsel;
verses.22:8: and you showed partiality to certain persons, and you settled those upon the earth;
verses.22:9: and you sent widows away empty, and you afflicted orphans.
verses.22:10: Therefore snares have surrounded you, and a fierce war has alarmed you.
verses.22:11: The light has turned to darkness for you, and when you lay down to sleep, water covered you.
verses.22:12: Does not He who dwells in the high places look down, and has He not humbled those who are carried along in arrogance?
verses.22:13: And you said, 'What does the Mighty One know? Or does He judge through the thick darkness?
verses.22:14: A cloud is His hiding place, and He will not be seen, and He walks along the circuit of heaven.'
verses.22:15: Will you keep the ancient path which righteous men have trodden,
verses.22:16: who were seized before their time? Their foundations are an overflowing river;
verses.22:17: who say, 'What will the Lord do to us? Or what will the Almighty bring upon us?'
verses.22:18: Yet it was He who filled their houses with good things, and the counsel of the ungodly is far from Him.
verses.22:19: The righteous saw it and laughed, and the blameless one mocked;
verses.22:20: truly their substance has been wiped out, and fire shall devour their remnant.
verses.22:21: Be steadfast now, if you will endure; then your fruit shall be among good things.
verses.22:22: Bring forth declaration from His mouth, and take up His words in your heart.
verses.22:23: And if you turn back and humble yourself before the Lord, you have put what is unjust far from your dwelling;
verses.22:24: you shall be set upon a mound on a rock, and as a rock of the torrent of Sophir.
verses.22:25: Therefore the Almighty shall be your helper against enemies, and He shall restore you pure as silver refined by fire.
verses.22:26: Then you shall have boldness before the Lord, looking up cheerfully to heaven;
verses.22:27: and when you pray to Him, He will hear you, and He will grant you to pay your vows;
verses.22:28: and He will restore to you a dwelling of righteousness, and upon your ways there shall be radiance.
verses.22:29: Because you have humbled yourself, you shall also say, 'He acted proudly,' and He will save the one with downcast eyes;
verses.22:30: He will deliver the innocent, and be saved through your clean hands."
verses.23:2: "Indeed I know that argument is out of my hand, and His hand has become heavy upon my groaning.
verses.23:3: And who indeed could know that I might find Him, and come to the end?
verses.23:4: Then I would speak my own case, and my mouth would fill with arguments;
verses.23:5: and I would know the remedies which He will speak to me, and perceive what things He will declare to me.
verses.23:6: And in great strength He will come upon me; then He will not deal with me with a threat.
verses.23:7: For truth and reproof are from Him, and may He bring forth my judgment to the end.
verses.23:8: For I shall go to the first things, and I am no more; and as for the last things, what do I know?
verses.23:9: When He worked on the left, I did not lay hold of Him; He will turn to the right, and I shall not see Him.
verses.23:10: For He already knows my way, and He has tested me as gold.
verses.23:11: And I shall go forth in His commandments, for I have kept His ways, and I shall never turn aside; from His commandments,
verses.23:12: I shall never depart, and in my bosom I have hidden His words.
verses.23:13: And if He Himself has judged thus, who is he who contradicts Him? For whatever He Himself willed, He also did.
verses.23:15: Therefore I have been alarmed at Him; and being admonished, I took thought of Him. For this reason I am dismayed before His presence; I shall consider, and I shall be terrified because of Him.
verses.23:16: And the Lord has made my heart faint, and the Almighty has dismayed me.
verses.23:17: For I did not know that darkness would come upon me, and thick darkness has covered before my face."
verses.24:1: "And why have seasons escaped the notice of the Lord,
verses.24:2: while the ungodly have overstepped a boundary, seizing a flock together with its shepherd?
verses.24:3: They led away the beast of burden of orphans, and took the widow's ox as a pledge.
verses.24:4: They turned the weak aside from the righteous way, and with one accord the meek of the earth hid themselves.
verses.24:5: And they departed like donkeys in a field, having gone out of their own order beyond me; bread became sweet to him for the young.
verses.24:6: They reaped before its season a field that was not theirs; the weak worked the vineyards of the ungodly without wages and without food.
verses.24:7: They made many lie down naked without garments, and they took away the covering of their soul;
verses.24:8: they are drenched by the showers of the mountains; because they have no shelter for themselves, they have embraced a rock.
verses.24:9: They snatched the orphan from the breast, and they humbled the one who had fallen.
verses.24:10: And they made them lie down naked unjustly, and they took away the morsel of the hungry.
verses.24:11: In narrow places they lay in ambush unjustly, and they did not know the way of the righteous.
verses.24:12: They were cast out from the city and their own houses, and the soul of infants groaned aloud.
verses.24:13: And why has He Himself not made a visitation of these things? While they were upon the earth, they did not recognize it; they did not know the way of righteousness, nor did they walk in their paths.
verses.24:14: Yet knowing their works, He delivered them over to darkness, and by night he shall be as a thief.
verses.24:15: And the eye of the adulterer watched for darkness, saying, 'No eye will notice me,' and he put a concealment upon his face.
verses.24:16: In darkness he dug through houses; by day they sealed themselves in; they did not recognize the light;
verses.24:17: for to them all together the morning is the shadow of death, for he will recognize the terror of the shadow of death.
verses.24:18: He is light upon the face of the water; may their portion upon the earth be cursed,
verses.24:19: and may their plants appear withered upon the earth; for they have snatched the sheaf of orphans.
verses.24:20: Then his sin was brought to remembrance, and like a mist of dew he vanished away; may what he has done be repaid to him, and may every unrighteous one be shattered like an incurable tree.
verses.24:21: For he did not do good to the barren woman, and he showed no mercy to the one without a spouse,
verses.24:22: and in wrath he overthrew the weak. Therefore, when he rises up, he shall have no assurance for his own life;
verses.24:23: when he grows weak with sickness, let him not hope to be healed, but he shall fall by disease.
verses.24:24: For his exaltation afflicted many; and he withered like a mallow in the burning heat, or like an ear of grain falling of its own accord from the stalk.
verses.24:25: And if it is not so, who is he who says that I speak falsehood, and will bring my words to nothing?"
verses.25:1: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered, saying,
verses.25:2: "For what prelude or dread comes from Him, who makes the whole universe in the highest?
verses.25:3: For should anyone suppose that there is any delay for raiders? And upon whom will an ambush from Him not come?
verses.25:4: For how shall a mortal be righteous before the Lord? Or who, born of a woman, could cleanse himself?
verses.25:5: Indeed, He commands the moon, and it does not shine forth; and the stars are not pure in His sight.
verses.25:6: Alas, then, man is decay, and a son of man is a worm."
verses.26:2: "To whom are you attached, or whom are you about to help? Is it not the One who has great strength, and the One whose arm is mighty?
verses.26:3: To whom have you given counsel? Is it not the One who has all wisdom? Whom will you follow? Is it not the One who has the greatest power?
verses.26:4: To whom have you declared words? And whose breath is it that has come forth from you?
verses.26:5: Shall giants be brought to birth beneath the water and its neighbors?
verses.26:6: Hades is naked before Him, and there is no covering for Destruction.
verses.26:7: He stretches out the north upon nothing, and suspends the earth upon nothing.
verses.26:8: He binds up water in His clouds, and no cloud is torn open beneath it.
verses.26:9: He holds fast the face of the throne, spreading out His cloud over it.
verses.26:10: He drew a decree in a circle upon the face of the water, even to the end of light with darkness.
verses.26:11: The pillars of heaven flew apart, and were astounded at His rebuke.
verses.26:12: By strength He stilled the sea, and by knowledge the sea monster has been laid low.
verses.26:13: And the bars of heaven fear Him; and by a decree He slew the rebellious dragon.
verses.26:14: Behold, these are parts of His way, and we shall hear a mere drop of a word concerning Him; but the might of His thunder, who knows when He will make it?"
verses.27:1: And Job continued his discourse further, saying,
verses.27:2: "As God lives, who has judged me thus, and the Almighty, who has embittered my soul,
verses.27:3: surely while my breath is still in me, and the divine spirit remains in my nostrils,
verses.27:4: my lips shall not speak lawless things, nor shall my soul meditate on unrighteous things.
verses.27:5: Far be it from me to declare you righteous until I die, for I will not put away my innocence;
verses.27:6: holding fast to righteousness, I will by no means abandon it, for I am not conscious within myself of having done anything wrong.
verses.27:7: Nevertheless, may my enemies be like the overthrow of the ungodly, and those who rise up against me like the destruction of the lawless.
verses.27:8: For what hope has an ungodly man, because he holds on? Trusting in the Lord, shall he indeed be saved?
verses.27:9: Or will God hear his supplication? Or when distress comes upon him,
verses.27:10: does he have any boldness before Him? Or when he calls upon Him, will He hear him?
verses.27:11: Now then, I will declare to you what is in the hand of the Lord; what is with the Almighty I will not falsify.
verses.27:12: Behold, you all know that you heap empty things upon empty things.
verses.27:13: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and the possession of tyrants shall come upon them from the Almighty.
verses.27:14: If their sons become many, they shall be for slaughter; and even if they grow to manhood, they shall beg;
verses.27:15: and no one shall have mercy on their widows.
verses.27:16: If he gathers silver like earth, and prepares gold like clay,
verses.27:17: all these things the righteous shall acquire, and true men shall possess his wealth.
verses.27:18: And his house has turned out like moths and like a spider.
verses.27:19: A rich man lies down to sleep and shall not do so again; he opens his eyes, and he is no more.
verses.27:20: Pains have met him like water, and by night thick darkness has snatched him away.
verses.27:21: A scorching wind shall take him up, and he shall depart, and it shall winnow him out of his place.
verses.27:22: And it shall hurl him down and will not spare; from its hand he shall flee headlong.
verses.27:23: They shall clap their hands at him, and hiss him out of his place."
verses.28:1: For there is a place for silver from which it comes, and a place for gold where it is refined;
verses.28:2: for iron comes from the earth, and copper is quarried like stone.
verses.28:3: He has set an order for darkness, and he himself thoroughly searches out every boundary—the stone of gloom and the shadow of death,
verses.28:4: a cleft of a torrent away from limestone; and those who forget the righteous way have grown weak away from mortals.
verses.28:5: The earth—out of it bread shall come forth; beneath it, it has been overturned like fire.
verses.28:6: Its stones are the place of sapphire, and it has dust of gold.
verses.28:7: A path—no bird has known it, and the eye of the vulture has not glanced upon it;
verses.28:8: and the sons of the arrogant have not trodden it, nor has a lion passed over it.
verses.28:9: He stretched forth his hand upon the flinty rock, and overturned mountains from their roots;
verses.28:10: he broke open the whirlpools of rivers, and my eye has seen every precious thing;
verses.28:11: he uncovered the depths of rivers, and displayed his own power to the light.
verses.28:12: But from where has wisdom been found? And what is the place of knowledge?
verses.28:13: A mortal does not know its way, nor indeed has it been found among men.
verses.28:14: The abyss said, "It is not in me," and the sea said, "It is not with me."
verses.28:15: One shall not give an enclosure in return for it, and silver shall not be weighed out for it as its exchange;
verses.28:16: neither shall it be weighed against the gold of Sophir, with precious onyx and sapphire;
verses.28:17: gold and crystal shall not be equaled to it, nor shall vessels of gold be its exchange.
verses.28:18: Lofty things and gabis shall not be mentioned; and draw up wisdom above the innermost things.
verses.28:19: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not be equaled to it; it shall not be weighed against pure gold.
verses.28:20: But from where has wisdom been found? And what is the place of understanding?
verses.28:21: It has escaped the notice of every man, and from the birds of heaven it has been concealed.
verses.28:22: Destruction and Death said, "We have heard its report."
verses.28:23: God has well established its way, and He Himself knows its place.
verses.28:24: For He beholds all that is under heaven, knowing all the things upon the earth
verses.28:25: that He made, the weight of the winds, the measures of water,
verses.28:26: when He made them; thus, having seen them, He numbered them, and a way in shaking, and voices.
verses.28:27: Then He saw it and declared to it; having prepared it, He searched it out.
verses.28:28: And He said to man, "Behold, reverence for God is wisdom, and to abstain from evil is knowledge."
verses.29:1: And Job continued further and said in his discourse:
verses.29:2: "Who would set me as in a month of former days, in which God watched over me,
verses.29:3: as when His lamp shone above my head, when by His light I walked in darkness;
verses.29:4: when I was pressing heavily upon the ways, when God kept oversight of my house;
verses.29:5: when I was exceedingly luxuriant, and my children were all around me;
verses.29:6: when my ways flowed with butter, and my mountains flowed with milk;
verses.29:7: when I went forth early in the morning in the city, and my seat was set in the public squares?
verses.29:8: Seeing me, the young men hid themselves, and all the elders stood up;
verses.29:9: the nobles ceased speaking, laying a finger upon their mouth.
verses.29:10: Those who heard called me blessed, and their tongue clung to their throat;
verses.29:11: for the ear heard and called me blessed, and the eye, seeing me, turned aside.
verses.29:12: For I delivered the poor from the hand of the mighty, and I helped the orphan who had no helper;
verses.29:13: may the blessing of the perishing come upon me, and the mouth of the widow blessed me.
verses.29:14: I had put on righteousness, and I clothed myself with justice like a mantle.
verses.29:15: I was an eye to the blind, and a foot to the lame.
verses.29:16: I was a father to the helpless, and the cause which I did not know I searched out;
verses.29:17: I crushed the jaw-teeth of the unrighteous; from the midst of their teeth I snatched the prey.
verses.29:18: And I said, 'My age shall grow old; like the trunk of a palm tree, I shall live a long time;
verses.29:19: the root is opened out by the water, and the dew shall abide in my harvest;
verses.29:20: my glory is new with me, and my bow goes forth in his hand.'
verses.29:21: Having heard me, they gave heed, and they kept silent at my counsel;
verses.29:22: to my word they added nothing, and they became overjoyed whenever I spoke to them;
verses.29:23: as thirsty earth awaits the rain, so did these await my speech.
verses.29:24: If I smiled at them, they would not believe it; and the light of my countenance did not fall away.
verses.29:25: I chose their way and sat as chief, and I dwelt like a king among warriors, in the manner of one who comforts the afflicted."
verses.30:1: But now they have laughed me to scorn; the least of men now admonish me in turn, whose fathers I held in contempt, whom I did not deem worthy of the dogs of my flocks.
verses.30:2: Indeed, of what use to me is the strength of their hands? Upon them completeness has perished.
verses.30:3: Barren in want and famine, those who fled yesterday a waterless land, distress, and misery;
verses.30:4: those who go around gathering saltwort by what resounds, whose food was salt herbs—dishonored and despised, lacking every good thing.
verses.30:5: Thieves have risen up against me,
verses.30:6: whose dwellings were holes in the rocks;
verses.30:7: in the midst of resonant places they shall cry out, who made their dwelling beneath wild brushwood;
verses.30:8: sons of fools and a name of dishonorable men, and renown extinguished from the earth.
verses.30:9: And now I am their harp, and they hold me as a byword;
verses.30:10: they have abhorred me, standing far aloof, and they did not withhold spittle from my face.
verses.30:11: For He has opened His quiver and afflicted me, and He has cast away the bridle of my face.
verses.30:12: At the right hand of the shoot they rose up; they stretched out their foot, and they prepared against me the paths of their destruction.
verses.30:13: My paths have been worn away, for they have stripped off my robe;
verses.30:14: With His arrows He has struck me down; He has dealt with me as He wills; I am overwhelmed in pains.
verses.30:15: My pains turn back upon me; my hope has vanished like a wind, and like a cloud my deliverance.
verses.30:16: And now my soul shall be poured out upon me, and days of pains hold me fast;
verses.30:17: and by night my bones are confounded, and my sinews are loosened.
verses.30:18: With great strength He has taken hold of my robe; like the collar of my tunic He has clasped me round.
verses.30:19: And You have reckoned me equal to clay; in earth and ashes is my portion.
verses.30:20: I have cried out to You, and You do not hear me; and they stood and gazed closely upon me;
verses.30:21: they came upon me without mercy; with a mighty hand You have scourged me;
verses.30:22: and You have set me in pains, and cast me away from deliverance.
verses.30:23: For I know that death shall crush me, for the earth is a house for every mortal.
verses.30:24: Oh, that I were able to lay violent hands upon myself, or at least to implore another, and he would do this for me!
verses.30:25: Yet I wept over every helpless one, and I groaned when I saw a man in distress.
verses.30:26: And while I waited for good things, behold, days of evils came upon me instead.
verses.30:27: My inward parts have boiled over and shall not be silent; days of poverty have overtaken me.
verses.30:28: Groaning I have walked without a muzzle, and I have stood in the assembly crying out.
verses.30:29: I have become a brother of sirens, and a companion of ostriches.
verses.30:30: And my skin has been greatly darkened, and my bones from burning heat.
verses.30:31: And my harp has turned into grief, and my song into weeping for me.
verses.31:1: I have made a covenant with my eyes, and I will not turn my thoughts upon a virgin.
verses.31:2: And moreover God has apportioned from above, and an inheritance of the Almighty from the highest places.
verses.31:3: Woe! Destruction is for the unrighteous, and estrangement for those who practice lawlessness.
verses.31:4: Will He not behold my way, and shall not all my steps be numbered?
verses.31:5: If I had walked with mockers, or if my foot also has hastened toward deceit—
verses.31:6: for I have been weighed in a just balance, and the Lord knows my innocence—
verses.31:7: if my foot has turned aside from the way, or if my heart also has followed after the eye, or if with my hands also I have touched bribes—
verses.31:8: then may I sow and let others eat, and may I become rootless upon the earth.
verses.31:9: If my heart has followed after the wife of another man, or if I also have lain in wait at her doors—
verses.31:10: then may my wife also please another, and may my little children be brought low.
verses.31:11: For an unrestrainable fury of wrath is the defiling of a man's wife;
verses.31:12: for it is a fire burning in all parts, and wherever it comes, it destroys from the roots.
verses.31:13: And if I also despised the cause of my manservant or maidservant when they contended against me—
verses.31:14: for what shall I do if the Lord makes an examination of me? And if He also makes a visitation, what answer shall I give?
verses.31:15: Just as I also was formed in the womb, were they not also formed? Indeed, we were formed in the same womb.
verses.31:16: And the helpless did not fail to receive whatever need they had, nor did I cause the eye of the widow to waste away.
verses.31:17: And if I also ate my morsel alone, and did not share it with the orphan—
verses.31:18: for from my youth I nourished them as a father, and from my mother's womb I guided them—
verses.31:19: and if I also overlooked a naked man perishing, and did not clothe him;
verses.31:20: and if the helpless did not bless me, while their shoulders were warmed from the shearing of my lambs;
verses.31:21: if I lifted up my hand against an orphan, trusting that abundant help was at my disposal,
verses.31:22: then may my shoulder fall away from the collarbone, and may my arm be shattered from the elbow.
verses.31:23: For dread seized me, and by reason of His burden I cannot endure.
verses.31:24: If I appointed gold as my dust, or if I also trusted in a precious stone,
verses.31:25: or if I also rejoiced when my wealth became abundant, or if I also laid my hand upon countless things;
verses.31:26: Or do we not see the shining sun failing, and the moon waning? For it is not in their power.
verses.31:27: And if my heart was secretly deceived, and if, laying my hand upon my mouth, I kissed it—
verses.31:28: then may this also be reckoned to me as the greatest lawlessness, because I have lied before the Lord Most High.
verses.31:29: And if I also gloated over the downfall of my enemies, and my heart said, "Well done!"—
verses.31:30: then may my ear hear my curse, and may I be made a byword by my people while afflicted.
verses.31:31: And if my maidservants also often said, "Who would grant us to be filled with his flesh?"—though I was exceedingly kind—
verses.31:32: and no stranger lodged outside, for my door stood open to everyone who came;
verses.31:33: and if also, having sinned unwittingly, I concealed my sin—
verses.31:34: for I was not abashed before the throng of the multitude so as not to confess before them—and if I also allowed a helpless man to go out of my door with an empty bosom—
verses.31:35: Who would grant me one who hears me? And if I had not feared the hand of the Lord, the written bond that I held against anyone
verses.31:36: putting it upon my shoulders as a crown, I would have read it aloud;
